nodes.title: Import forms and the one pipe the template uses
nodes.why: FormsModule supplies ngModel for the three controls, and the only other template dependency is the pipe that capitalizes the role pill, so TitleCasePipe is imported on its own.
nodes.alternative: Import CommonModule for a single pipe, or drop it without checking which pipes the external template still uses.
nodes.tradeoff: The import list names exactly what the template needs; another pipe added later needs its own import.

nodes.title: Hold each filter in a signal
nodes.why: [(ngModel)] writes the search text, the role and the toggle straight into writable signals, and the computed list depends on exactly those three values.
nodes.alternative: Plain fields read by a getter, which works while every change comes from a control in this template.
nodes.tradeoff: Signals add call syntax in TypeScript, but OnPush and the computed list also see changes made outside this template, such as filters restored from the URL.

nodes.title: Normalize the search term once
nodes.why: One normalized value makes name matching case-insensitive and avoids repeated cleanup inside the filter callback.
nodes.alternative: Compare raw input separately for every user row.
nodes.tradeoff: Normalization allocates a small string per recomputation, but the filtering rules stay readable.

nodes.title: Treat all as the role wildcard
nodes.why: The wildcard must bypass role rejection while concrete roles match exactly.
nodes.alternative: Compare every user role directly to the selected value, including all.
nodes.tradeoff: The explicit branch is slightly longer, but it makes the filter contract unambiguous.

nodes.title: Compose the active-only constraint
nodes.why: Inactive users are rejected only while the toggle is on, and the source array stays intact.
nodes.alternative: Mutate the source users array whenever the toggle changes.
nodes.tradeoff: The computed reruns the whole filter when any of the three signals changes, which is cheap for five users and keeps the canonical data intact.
